title: Standing seam metal re-roof
summary: Existing shingles removed, high-temperature underlayment, 16" standing seam panels with concealed clips. Choose a metal product in Materials before playing.

steps.title: Tear off existing shingles
steps.detail: Shingles and felt come off; the deck must be flat for metal panels, so every nail is pulled.

steps.title: Re-nail and repair the deck
steps.detail: Sheathing re-nailed to the rafters at 6" o.c. and soft spots replaced.

steps.title: High-temp ice & water
steps.detail: Smooth high-temperature membrane at the eaves and valleys; metal gets hot enough to soften granular membranes.

steps.title: Panel clips
steps.detail: Clips at every seam, 24" o.c., allow thermal movement.

steps.title: Set the panels
steps.detail: Panels run eave to ridge, set left to right and mechanically seamed.

steps.title: Vented ridge and caps
steps.detail: Vented closure strip and matching ridge and hip caps.
